searches.reason: Develop controlled probes for whether recommendations depend on recent intent, repeated narrow preferences, or broad historical associations. Compare original histories with recent-event removal, older-event removal, and order perturbations; connect ranking changes to sequence representations and attention components without claiming causal identification from observational histories.
searches.query: sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation recent intent repeated preferences history perturbation order shuffling shortcut learning representation sensitivity 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into evidence-based recommendation audits using only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions. Seek methods that distinguish supported complements, possible substitutes, explicit specification conflicts, and insufficient evidence, with abstention when ownership, compatibility, or purchase satisfaction cannot be established. Avoid treating unknown relevance as dislike or requiring pretrained weights.
searches.query: recommendation evidence grounded diagnostics complementary substitute products compatibility constraints purchase history title description uncertainty abstention weak supervision without pretrained models 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Make diagnostics trustworthy and actionable through controlled failure injection, reproducibility checks, and uncertainty estimates. Examine sampled-candidate versus full-catalog ranking discrepancies, validate whether probes detect known failures, and test associations with per-dataset and macro validation HR@10 under a fixed validation budget. Seek component and training-loss ablations that explain failures without changing the host evaluator.
searches.query: recommender system diagnostic metric validation controlled corruption negative controls sampled ranking full catalog evaluation bootstrap uncertainty component ablation sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026
